sentence: Kayleigh Brennan is the tenant; she lives with her children Alfie (seven) and Mia (three) at Flat 4, 18 Cobden Street, a two-bedroom flat on the top floor.
Kayleigh has lived at the address since the summer of 2021 through Kerridge and Lowe agents; the landlord is Mr Haskins.
Kayleigh was on the tenancy alone; her ex-partner Liam was on the tenancy with her until the day after Alfie's birthday (9 August), when he moved out. Liam is now in Bristol.
The current rent is £895 a month (increased in April). Universal Credit covers £725 for housing, leaving Kayleigh short £170 a month.
Kayleigh works 12 hours a week in the kitchen at Cobden Road Primary and earns approximately £630 a month.
Kayleigh has no child maintenance from Liam and no savings.
Kayleigh has arrears of £1,960 as of 2 November (Liam had previously estimated £2,400). She was behind on housing money for August and September due to a five-week delay in re-appe
Kayleigh has never been in arrears before and has never been evicted.
